name: Keywraith
summary: An arcade typing game where enemies drift down carrying words. The first letter you press locks onto the most urgent matching enemy and every letter after that fires at it, so choosing a target and typing are the same action. Some enemies change what typing the word requires: one must be typed backwards, one re-rolls its word until you commit, one splits in two when destroyed, and one erases all your progress on a single wrong key. Three paces, six handcrafted levels with a boss, and a daily challenge shared by every player. Free, no ads, no account needed, and it needs a physical keyboard.
